title: Quantum mechanics founded
summary: Heisenberg, Born and Jordan created matrix mechanics, the first logically consistent formulation of quantum mechanics.
interchange: Erwin Schrödinger's wave mechanics (1926) was an equivalent formulation

notes.problem: Source: 'first conceptually autonomous and logically consistent formulation', not 'first complete theory'.

superlativeSource: the first conceptually autonomous and logically consistent formulation of quantum mechanics
